property_summary: The version() function must always return '1.0.0' for any caller, but the mutant returns '2.0.0'.
Only the depositor account can successfully call setL1BlockValues without causing a revert.
A non-depositor caller must always cause setL1BlockValues to revert.

The setL1BlockValues function should revert for any caller other than the constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT; the mutant makes it revert for all callers (including DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT) because it checks against address(0), so DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT can never succeed.
setL1BlockValues never reverts when called by DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT in the reference, but reverts for the same caller in the mutant.
A call to setL1BlockValues from DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT must not revert; the mutant makes it revert because it checks msg.sender == address(0) instead of DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT.
A call to setL1BlockValues from DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT must succeed; the mutant makes it revert because it checks msg.sender == address(0) instead of DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT.
For any caller, setL1BlockValues reverts only when the caller is not DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT; the mutant incorrectly reverts for DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT because it checks against address(0).
